email_messages.subject: Reminder: W-8 recertification sweep for 2026
email_messages.body:
AP team,

Forms W-8BEN/W-8BEN-E expire on the last day of the third calendar year after signature. Any vendor whose certificate expiry has passed reverts to the statutory non-resident rate until a new form is received - regardless of what they assert in correspondence, and regardless of the fact that the old form is still visible on the vendor record.

Do not take an emailed treaty claim as a filing.

Contoso Tax (SIMULATION)
